basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Project Research Scientist III (Psychiatry) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Psychiatry, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Ansari Nagar, New Delhi, is filling one Project Research Scientist-III (Medical) post on the ICMR-funded project I-2030 on geriatric mental health. The project runs for 3 years. Pay is Rs. 93,000 plus HRA @ 30% (Rs 1,20,900 per month) as per ICMR Guidelines. The essential qualification is MBBS plus a Post Graduate Degree (MD / DNB) in Psychiatry with three years of post-qualification experience, and the age limit is 45 years. rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Ansari Nagar, New Delhi
I-2030, titled "Development and Validation of Digital Intervention for Geriatric Patients with Cognitive Impairment and Care Givers (vs Care as Usual): Two-Arm Parallel Randomized Controlled Trial"
Project duration 3 years; tenure six months initially, with extension up to 3 years depending on performance
As per ICMR Guidelines – Rs. 93,000 + HRA @ 30% [= Rs 1,20,900/Month]

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one post with one set of conditions. MBBS plus Post Graduate Degree (MD / DNB) in Psychiatry, with three years post qualification experience. Experience of working in Geriatric Mental Health. Experience of working with patients with dementia. Experience in clinical research and project management. At least one publication. The age limit is 45 Years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The project duration is 3 years. The tenure will be for six months initially, with extension up to 3 years depending on performance. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview.

rows.pay_monthly_emoluments: As per ICMR Guidelines – Rs. 93,000 + HRA @ 30% [= Rs 1,20,900/Month]

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Project Research Scientist-III (Medical)
content_sections.text: Submit your application at the online form https://forms.gle/9yNSJWbs2aq2cLZU6 . Submit the CV and documents online by 30 November 2026, 23:59 IST. Do not send a hand-delivered or hard copy application. All applications are to be submitted online, and no hard copy will be accepted. The notice does not list the individual documents to upload. It asks candidates to bring original documents at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview. The notice does not give an interview date, venue or mode. Eligible candidates are requested to bring their original documents at the time of interview.
